label: TOKUSEIINFO_246
text: The Pokémon is protected by ice scales, which halve\nthe damage taken from special moves.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_247
text: Ripens Berries and doubles their effect.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_248
text: The Pokémon’s ice head can take a physical attack as\na substitute, but the attack also changes the Pokémon’s\nappearance. The ice will be restored when it snows.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_249
text: Just being next to the Pokémon powers up moves.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_250
text: Changes the Pokémon’s type depending on the terrain.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_251
text: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the effects of\nLight Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil are nullified for\nboth opposing and ally Pokémon.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_252
text: Powers up the Steel-type moves of the Pokémon\nand its allies.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_253
text: When hit by a move that makes direct contact, the\nPokémon and the attacker will faint after three turns\nunless they switch out of battle.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_254
text: The Pokémon exchanges Abilities with a Pokémon that\nhits it with a move that makes direct contact.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_255
text: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat but only allows the\nuse of the first selected move.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_256
text: While the Pokémon is in the battle, the effects of all\nother Pokémon’s Abilities will be nullified or will not\nbe triggered.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_257
text: Prevents the Pokémon and its allies from being\npoisoned.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_258
text: The Pokémon changes its form, alternating between\nits Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode after the end of\nevery turn.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_259
text: Enables the Pokémon to move first occasionally.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_260
text: If the Pokémon uses moves that make direct contact,\nit can attack the target even if the target protects itself.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_261
text: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it scatters medicine\nfrom its shell, which removes all stat changes from allies.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_262
text: Powers up Electric-type moves.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_263
text: Powers up Dragon-type moves.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_264
text: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a\nchilling neigh, which boosts its Attack stat.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_265
text: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a\nterrifying neigh, which boosts its Sp. Atk stat.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_266
text: This Ability combines the effects of both Calyrex’s\nUnnerve Ability and Glastrier’s Chilling Neigh Ability.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_267
text: This Ability combines the effects of both Calyrex’s\nUnnerve Ability and Spectrier’s Grim Neigh Ability.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_268
text: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker’s\nAbility to Lingering Aroma.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_269
text: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon\nis hit by an attack.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_270
text: Boosts the Attack stat when the Pokémon is hit by a\nFire-type move. The Pokémon also cannot be burned.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_271
text: When an attack causes its HP to drop to half or less, the\nPokémon gets angry. This lowers its Defense and Sp. Def\nstats but boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_272
text: The Pokémon’s pure salt protects it from status\nconditions and halves the damage taken from\nGhost-type moves.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_273
text: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Fire-type\nmoves. Instead, its Defense stat is sharply boosted.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_274
text: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat if Tailwind takes effect\nor if the Pokémon is hit by a wind move. The Pokémon\nalso takes no damage from wind moves.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_275
text: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat if intimidated.\nMoves and items that would force the Pokémon\nto switch out also fail to work.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_276
text: Powers up Rock-type moves.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_277
text: The Pokémon becomes charged when it is hit by a wind\nmove, boosting the power of the next Electric-type\nmove the Pokémon uses.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_278
text: The Pokémon transforms into its Hero Form when it\nswitches out.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_279
text: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it goes inside the\nmouth of an ally Dondozo if one is on the field.\nThe Pokémon then issues commands from there.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_280
text: The Pokémon becomes charged when it takes damage,\nboosting the power of the next Electric-type move the\nPokémon uses.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_281
text: Boosts the Pokémon’s most proficient stat in harsh\nsunlight or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_282
text: Boosts the Pokémon’s most proficient stat on Electric\nTerrain or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_283
text: A body of pure, solid gold gives the Pokémon full\nimmunity to other Pokémon’s status moves.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_284
text: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous vessel lowers the\nSp. Atk stats of all Pokémon except itself.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_285
text: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous sword lowers the\nDefense stats of all Pokémon except itself.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_286
text: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous wooden tablets\nlowers the Attack stats of all Pokémon except itself.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_287
text: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous beads lowers the\nSp. Def stats of all Pokémon except itself.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_288
text: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a\nbattle. The ancient pulse thrumming through the\nPokémon also boosts its Attack stat in harsh sunlight.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_289
text: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon\nenters a battle. The futuristic engine within the Pokémon\nalso boosts its Sp. Atk stat on Electric Terrain.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_290
text: If an opponent’s stat is boosted, the Pokémon seizes the\nopportunity to boost the same stat for itself.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_291
text: When the Pokémon eats a Berry, it will regurgitate\nthat Berry at the end of the next turn and eat it one\nmore time.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_292
text: Powers up slicing moves.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_293
text: When the Pokémon enters a battle, its Attack and\nSp. Atk stats are slightly boosted for each of the allies\nin its party that have already been defeated.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_294
text: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it copies an ally’s\nstat changes.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_295
text: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team\nwhen the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_296
text: The mysterious tail covering the Pokémon’s head makes\nopponents unable to use priority moves against the\nPokémon or its allies.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_297
text: If hit by a Ground-type move, the Pokémon has its HP\nrestored instead of taking damage.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_298
text: The Pokémon will always act more slowly when using\nstatus moves, but these moves will be unimpeded by\nthe Ability of the target.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_299
text: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it showers its ally\nwith hospitality, restoring a small amount of the ally’s HP.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_300
text: The Pokémon ignores changes to opponents’\nevasiveness, its accuracy can’t be lowered, and it can\nhit Ghost types with Normal- and Fighting-type moves.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_301
text: The Pokémon’s heart fills with memories, causing the\nTeal Mask to shine and the Pokémon’s Speed stat to\nbe boosted.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_302
text: The Pokémon’s heart fills with memories, causing the\nHearthflame Mask to shine and the Pokémon’s Attack\nstat to be boosted.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_303
text: The Pokémon’s heart fills with memories, causing the\nWellspring Mask to shine and the Pokémon’s Sp. Def\nstat to be boosted.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_304
text: The Pokémon’s heart fills with memories, causing the\nCornerstone Mask to shine and the Pokémon’s Defense\nstat to be boosted.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_305
text: The power of the Pokémon’s toxic chain may badly\npoison any target the Pokémon hits with a move.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_306
text: A sickly sweet scent spreads across the field the\nfirst time the Pokémon enters a battle, lowering\nthe evasiveness of opposing Pokémon.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_308
text: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it absorbs the energy\naround itself and transforms into its Terastal Form.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_309
text: The Pokémon’s shell contains the powers of each type.\nAll damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its\nHP is full will not be very effective.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_310
text: When Terapagos changes into its Stellar Form, it uses\nits hidden powers to eliminate all effects of weather and\nterrain, reducing them to zero.

label: TOKUSEIINFO_311
text: Pokémon poisoned by Pecharunt’s moves will also\nbecome confused.
